question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Huge fire for celebration
solution:
The correct answer is "**Bonfire.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• **A bonfire is a large outdoor fire, often used for celebration or as part of a ritual.**(अलाव)

 
 
• Example: With bonfires outlawed in urban areas, gardeners must cart their refuse to a dump.
 
 
 
 
 
• The word 'bonfire' can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words, 'huge fire for celebration'.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
